[[File:TantiveIVBosun-SWCTP.png|thumb|right|250px|A bosun serving on the ''Tantive IV'' in 19 BBY]]
'''Bosun''' was the informal name attributed to a ship officer in charge of maintaining maximum efficiency of the bridge systems of a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]]. Bosuns were also called upon to aid in more general duties, such as directing [[Binary loadlifter/Legends|loadlifters]]. A bosun was attributed the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Chief Petty Officer/Legends|Chief Petty Officer]] (CPO). The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] all employed bosuns aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

==Behind the scenes==
"Bosun" is the phonetic spelling of the English "[[Wikipedia:Boatswain|boatswain]]," a nautical term for a petty officer in charge of a ship's anchors, colors, deck crew and boats.
